jobs.description: As a warehouse operator at DSV Contract Logistics B.V., you make sure goods move quickly and safely to the right place. You’ll work in a close-knit team, get lots of responsibility, and learn every day. This is your chance to really make an impact in logistics! Wat ga je doen? As a warehouse operator, you’re the key player in the logistics process. DSV values its employees by providing clear communication, structured planning, and plenty of opportunities for personal and professional development. Wie ben je?
